description: This file is a C header file defining the interface for RTL8367C switch high-level API related to Energy Efficient Ethernet (EEE) features. It declares external functions for setting and getting EEE configurations on network ports, and includes relevant macros and includes.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicEee100M
methods.description: Sets the EEE state (enable/disable) for 100M ports.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicEee100M
methods.description: Gets the EEE state for 100M ports.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicEeeGiga
methods.description: Sets the EEE state (enable/disable) for gigabit ports.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicEeeGiga
methods.description: Gets the EEE state for gigabit ports.
